name: Black Widow
author: Arkady, NIco & Hyper (M.U.G.E.N); UMF conversion
description: Natasha Romanoff, rebuilt from the M.U.G.E.N Black Widow as an umf/2 fighter: Widow's Bite darts, charged elemental Widow's Sting, Gas Grenade, Deadly Spin and the sniper hyper, plus MCU-inspired Bite Overload, Widow's Line, the hidden S.H.I.E.L.D. Backup and the Red Ledger ultimate.
taunt: You're predictable. That's a compliment... for me.
winQuote: The ledger's a little less red today.

moves.name: S.H.I.E.L.D. Backup
moves.note: Hidden in the original .cmd (Hyper4, commented out): Agent Coulson's truck and the strike team, unlocked.

moves.name: Widow's Bite: Overload
moves.note: MCU: both gauntlets dump their charge as three electric darts.

moves.name: Widow's Line
moves.note: MCU: grapple line from the bracelets zips her behind the target for a spinning kick.

moves.name: Red Ledger
moves.input: ~D, DF, F, D, DF, F, x+y
moves.note: MCU: the Red Room conditioning taken to its limit; vanish, reappear behind and spin the full Deadly Spin chain.
